name: @flowforge/session-log-export
description: FlowForge Session-log ZIP export — streams one canonical-JSONL archive per Session tree (root + subagent descendants + every referenced attachment) with fflate incremental DEFLATE and pull-driven backpressure. Ported from dsh `session-log-export`. Zero runtime `@deepseek/*` references: every backend (Session log source, attachment store, lineage, live-session flush) enters through injected in-package ports with real memory implementations.
